name: Skeleton
description: Loading placeholder that mirrors the layout of incoming content.

ariaRequirements: role=status with aria-label naming what is loading
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-28 — Promoted from alpha: Example + ForcedColors stories present; Storybook axe gate enabled.

forbiddenUse: use Skeleton for measurable work (uploads, multi-step jobs); that is Progress territory.
leave skeletons on screen after content fails to load; resolve to an error state instead.
prefersOver: Spinner when the loading region has a layout worth mirroring
dense: layout-mirroring loading placeholder; variant text|circle|rect|avatar|card, text takes lines, free width/height; role=status, shimmer respects reduced motion

usage.description: Skeleton holds the shape of content that is still loading so the layout never jumps: pick the variant that mirrors what will appear (text with a lines count, avatar, card, or free-form rect/circle sized via width/height) and compose several to sketch the incoming view. Each skeleton is a polite role=status with an aria-label; the shimmer is decorative and turns off under prefers-reduced-motion. Family rule: Skeleton for layouts, Spinner for sub-second unknown waits, Progress for measurable work.

bestPractices.description: Mirror the real layout — same widths, heights, and rhythm as the content that will replace it — so the swap is seamless.
Name what is loading in the label prop ("Loading article", not "Loading content") for assistive tech.
Compose variants (avatar + text lines inside a card) to sketch whole modules; see the ComposedPage example.
Give one composed region one label and mark the rest decorative where possible; a page of chattering live regions is noise.
Do not keep skeletons on screen when loading fails — resolve to an error state; a forever-shimmer reads as a hang.
Do not use Skeleton for measurable work like uploads; Progress communicates completion, Skeleton only promises layout.
